frequency_question: How often does a central bank implement an incremental reserve ratio tool within a comparable 4-month window?
membership_rule: Includes central banks in major emerging economies that have statutory authority for variable reserve ratios and have faced systemic banking sector liquidity overhangs; excludes permanent statutory ratio changes.

cases.name: RBI alternate liquidity absorption episodes (historical equivalents)
Bank of Indonesia supplementary reserve ratio adjustments
Central Bank of Brazil compulsory deposit requirement adjustments

provenance_note: claims 40 cases from only 4 named (10.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 4 named historical instances of targeted incremental reserve requirements; estimated roughly 40 comparable policy windows globally in similar liquidity conditions
known_gaps: Varying definitions of liquidity surplus across different jurisdictions and central bank statutory frameworks.
skeleton: Total policy review windows across comparable emerging market central banks facing liquidity overhangs
multiplier: 4 observed instances of targeted liquidity absorption tools in similar windows out of 40 comparable central bank policy review cycles
validity_reason: Central bank liquidity management frameworks and statutory reserve tools evolve slowly over decades.
